notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.3.2 is live!

This update adds a new way to navigate the Adventure menu, and fixes a huge bug in Boss fights.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Adventure menu has been reworked and the chapters are now integrated within the world map for easy navigation.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TWvDFIl.gif[/img]

[*] Major bug fix where Bosses used to still damage the reaper when their health reaches 0.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:

This update adds a lot of new things, now the levels have a grim and dark atmosphere thanks to the new color palette, new enemy type, new OSTs, a boss rework and bug fixes.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complete overhaul of the game's color palette.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gupPEeU.gif[/img]

[*] Reworked "The Wise One" boss attacks and animations.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2HGhTE1.gif[/img]

[*] New enemy type in Chapter 2.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q32LR2e.gif[/img]

[*] New OSTs added, enjoy more climatic boss music.

[*] And A LOT of bug fixes as usual!
[/list]

notes.title: Reaper of Immortals is out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I'm so happy to announce that finally after so much effort, dedication and passion, my game is live on one of the biggest gaming platforms in the planet! And to me this alone is a big achievement.

I started working on ROI in late 2018 and published it on the Android platform in April 2020, and after couple years and dozen game updates I decided to port it to Steam, I started working on the port in May 2022 and after so many sleepless nights, moments of despair, complete burnouts, existential crisis episodes mingled with dp/dr and depression, ROI is finally public!

I'm not expecting my game to sell hundreds of thousands of copies (one can dream tho!), however, I'm content for every copy sold, ROI for me is not just a game, it's a life experience that taught me to how to be a thankful, patient and overall a good person.

To the fortunate souls who bought the game, know that your purchase is not merely a number that displays in my sales chart, ROI isn't just a product that I want to sell, I mainly made it to deliver a message, please play through all of the story.

notes.title: Reaper of Immortals is releasing in 2 days!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

After months of hard work and sleepless nights I'm finally happy to announce that my game will release in less than 48 hours!

Thanks to all who wishlisted my game and the ones who played through the Demo, see you all in Friday!

notes.title: Demo released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Originally I published my game Reaper of Immortals on Android in April 2020, last year I started working on porting my game to PC (Itch and Steam), I completely reworked the GUI, added some new game sections, in-game minimap, dynamic keyboard and controller compatibility, and a lot of bug fixes, I'm currently working on some new gameplay features, like adding new puzzles and balancing player/enemy stats.

The demo contains all of Chapter 1, playing through the demo should give you a good idea on how the game works and how the story progresses, please share your thoughts below or in the discussion section, every feedback will help me greatly improve the demo and the game as a whole.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PtzmlAu.png[/img]
